title: 340B Navigator on Microsoft Agent Framework
description: A private 22-lesson course on the Microsoft Agent Framework in C# and .NET 10, one framework feature per lesson, building a policy navigator for the 340B Drug Pricing Program as its capstone. A compliance engine computes every verdict and the model only picks the tools and explains the result, and risky actions wait for a person's approval. The capstone runs on Azure Functions; a merge that changes it redeploys it and runs a smoke test with the real model. All data is synthetic. One of a series of agent-framework courses built on the same skeleton so the frameworks can be compared like for like.
